firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently visited Russia opens the initial auction, unless the group agrees on another method.
clarifications: That starter makes the first bid or passes in the opening Red stock auction.
After the initial auctions, Phase 1 begins with the last person who bought a stock certificate. The setup starter is not necessarily the first player in Phase 1.
